Morning Brief — 2026-08-13

Focus today

  1. PPI 8:30 AM ET — consensus cool (5.1% exp); hot surprise = risk-off, BTC 63K test
  2. HCH overnight repositioning — CL + HYPE/LIT/PUMP shorts added; spot longs halved pre-event
  3. ETH 10-day binary — WR flagged direction resolves <10 days; $1,896 consolidation live

Since yesterday

  • [moved] KAITO: −27%/−50% 7d CAPITULATION — HCH+Stoiiic short theses validated, trade closed
  • [moved] HCH: trimmed BTC(−2.5%)/UNI(−1%)/PEPE(closed) shorts overnight; added CL + HYPE/LIT/PUMP shorts (1% each); halved spot longs
  • [moved] WR: fully closed SPCX at +40%; re-entry only if drops to POC ~$160
  • [moved] Swarmister: public BTC short declaration above 67K
  • [stuck] Swarmister BTC short DCA approval — pending since Aug 04, no Kyle response

Running today

  • x-trader-monitor: continuous (last success 07:32 UTC)
